trust_decision.summary: Whether an install/remove/reboot operation is allowed is decided by security_level read from config.ini under <user>/default/ComfyUI-Manager/, a directory ComfyUI's user-data API exposes to remote writers, so the policy input itself is attacker-writable; the published fix moves that state to the protected <user>/__manager path, raises a migrated level to 'normal' and forces 'strong' when the host has no System User API.

landing_point.why: the single place that composes the Manager data directory for the server and CLI; README:143 names the same legacy path

O8_uncovered_routes.route: startup-scripts/restore-snapshot.json is executed at boot (cm-cli restore-snapshot) from the same manager data dir; the fix blocks install-scripts.txt on old ComfyUI but leaves this file unblocked, so a file written through the unprotected user-data path still runs at next start
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: restore-snapshot is a documented legitimate feature and its HTTP trigger /snapshot/restore is already gated, so the boot handoff file looks like a trusted internal artifact
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: repo-root startup script, one file away from glob/manager_core.py

O8_uncovered_routes.route: pip_overrides.json / pip_blacklist.list / pip_auto_fix.list are loaded at boot from the manager data dir and can redirect package installs; on a host without the System User API the fix adds no block for them, only a path change that has no effect there
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: pip_overrides/blacklist are admin convenience files, not the security policy, and the migration already moves the directory
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: startup script plus glob/manager_util.py:494 in another module

O8_uncovered_routes.route: config.ini is written by /manager/preview_method, /manager/db_mode, /manager/policy/component, /manager/policy/update and /manager/channel_url_list with no is_allowed_security_level check at any level, including 'strong'
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: these are benign UI preferences chosen from predefined value lists and cannot set security_level itself, so they look unrelated to the policy file
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the gates but different routes, ~700 lines away
